*Second renewal reflects Connexus’ continued commitment to digital innovation, leveraging Alkami’s SDK to extend its development capabilities and deliver personalized member experiences*


**October 27, 2026 (Plano, Texas)** – Alkami Technology, Inc. (Nasdaq: ALKT) (“Alkami”), a[digital sales and service platform provider](https://www.alkami.com/) for financial institutions in the U.S., today highlighted the continued success of its longstanding partnership with Connexus Credit Union (Connexus). One of Alkami’s earliest customers, Connexus has renewed its partnership with Alkami for a second time, reaffirming its commitment to a flexible digital banking foundation that can evolve alongside member expectations and business priorities.


More than a decade after the partnership began, Connexus continues to use[Alkami’s Digital Banking Platform](https://www.alkami.com/digital-banking-solutions/) to deliver intuitive, personalized member experiences while supporting broader organizational goals around digital engagement, lending, and relationship growth. Connexus is also using Alkami’s[software development kit](https://www.alkami.com/digital-banking-solutions/retail-banking/banking-apis-and-sdks/) (SDK) to create custom digital experiences tailored to the credit union’s members and products.


“Connexus selected Alkami because we wanted a strategic technology partner that could support our long-term vision,” said Laura Huggins, senior vice president of marketing at Connexus Credit Union. “More than a decade later, that remains true. Alkami gives us a reliable foundation for the everyday member experience while providing the flexibility to build capabilities unique to Connexus and continue advancing our digital strategy. That’s why renewing our partnership was a natural decision.”


Through its use of Alkami’s Platform and SDK, Connexus has leveraged digital capabilities including[Snapshot](https://www.connexuscu.org/services/digital-banking/snapshot) , account alerts, internal and external transfers, card management, and created an[Xtraordinary Checking progress tracker](https://www.connexuscu.org/services/digital-banking/checking-progress-tool) to further differentiate its digital banking platform. These experiences help members manage everyday financial activities while making the value of Connexus’ products more relevant and visible within digital banking.


Connexus’ digital strategy is also contributing to measurable business results:


- Accelerated loan growth: 38% of lending application volume year-to-date comes through digital banking, up from 16% in 2020.
- Increased funding amount: 41% of total loan funding year-to-date comes through digital banking, compared with 12% in 2020.
- Deeper product adoption: Digital banking users hold approximately 17% more products per member than the average Connexus account holder.
- Improvement in member satisfaction: Connexus’ organizational Net Promoter Score (NPS) increased from 42.3 in 2022 to 58 in 2025, while digital banking NPS increased from 31.1 to 52.7 over the same period.
- Elevated engagement: Connexus’ mobile application has a 4.72 blended rating, including more than 14,000 Apple App Store ratings.


“Connexus demonstrates what is possible when a financial institution combines deep member knowledge, internal innovation, and a long-term technology partnership,” said Wayne McCulloch, chief customer officer at Alkami. “Connexus’ continued investment in digital banking is helping create more convenient member experiences while supporting meaningful business outcomes across engagement, lending, and relationship depth. We are proud to continue working alongside Connexus as they build what comes next.”


The expanded partnership story is featured in two recent resources from Alkami. The first[case study](https://www.alkami.com/resources/client-success/case-study/advancing-the-digital-banking-platform-through-more-than-a-decade-of-partnership-with-connexus/) explores how Connexus uses Alkami’s Digital Banking Platform and SDK to innovate from within, create custom member experiences, and support its broader digital strategy.


The companion whitepaper, “[Expanding the Relationship Beyond the Indirect Loan](https://www.alkami.com/resources/guides/whitepapers/expanding-the-relationship-beyond-the-indirect-loan/) ,” examines how financial institutions, like Connexus, can transform borrowers into deeper relationships.


“Indirect borrowers often did not intentionally choose Connexus Credit Union as their financial institution,” Huggins said. “They chose a car or another financial need, and Connexus became the lending partner that helped meet that need. We have to earn the opportunity to build a broader relationship by providing a simple, reliable, and relevant experience from the beginning.”


Through new member onboarding, digital banking enrollment, convenient loan[payments](https://www.alkami.com/digital-banking-solutions/business-banking/payments/) , targeted email and advertising campaigns, personalized in-app messaging, and internally developed next-best-product recommendations, Connexus is creating more opportunities to deepen adoption with additional products and services.


To read the Connexus digital banking case study, click[here](https://www.alkami.com/resources/client-success/case-study/advancing-the-digital-banking-platform-through-more-than-a-decade-of-partnership-with-connexus/) .


To read the whitepaper, Expanding the Relationship Beyond the Indirect Loan, click[here](https://www.alkami.com/resources/guides/whitepapers/expanding-the-relationship-beyond-the-indirect-loan/) .


To learn more about Anticipatory Banking and the Alkami Digital Sales & Service Platform, visit[here](https://www.alkami.com/digital-banking-solutions) .


**About Alkami**


[Alkami](https://www.alkami.com/press-room) provides a digital sales and service platform for U.S.[banks](https://www.alkami.com/banks/) and credit unions. Our unified Platform integrates onboarding, digital banking, and data and marketing—each solution can stand alone, but together they deliver more—to help institutions onboard, engage, and grow relationships. As the future shifts toward Anticipatory Banking, we help data-informed bankers meet the moment with technology that drives action.


**About Connexus Credit Union**


Connexus is a member-focused cooperative with $4.1 billion in assets, serving 420,000 members across all 50 states. Connexus is proud to provide high yields for checking accounts and deposit products, as well as an industry-leading Digital Banking experience and competitive rates for personal, home, and auto loans. The Wausau, WI-based credit union has been nationally recognized for excellence by Forbes, CNN Money, NerdWallet, Kiplinger, and Bankrate. Connexus is committed to being a nationally relevant, trusted credit union, providing exceptional experiences and fostering prosperity for those it serves.
